notes: Positive legal label-claim rule for the 55 Chassagne-Montrachet Premier Cru climats. The effective specification permits the listed climat names for both white and red wines meeting Premier Cru production conditions.

chassagne_bivb_spec_2011.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne
chassagne_bivb_spec_2011.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Chassagne-Montrachet homologué par le décret n°2011-1753
chassagne_bivb_spec_2011.scope: The effective specification enumerates the 55 climat names and authorizes their use with Premier Cru production conditions for white and red still wine.

rules.notes: All 55 listed Premier Cru climats are valid for both white and red Chassagne-Montrachet when the wine satisfies the corresponding Premier Cru production specification.
